Prerequisites: Berserker 4, Animal Fury rage power

When using the animal fury rage power while raging, the berserker's bite is able to pierce most resistances. At 4th level, his bite is treated as a magic weapon for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction. At 7th level, his bite is also treated as cold iron and silver for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction. At 10th level, his bite is also treated as a chaotic weapon for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction. At 16th level, his bite is treated as an adamantine weapon for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction and bypassing hardness.
